defs.def: a series of names, items, figures, etc., especially when they are written or printed 一览表；名单；目录；清单

ex.s: Even though Britain has a reputation for less-than-impressive cuisine, it is producing more top class chefs who appear frequently on our television screens and whose recipe books frequently top the best seller lists.
ex.t: 尽管英国菜以平庸著称，但英国正在培养越来越多的顶级厨师，他们频繁出现在我们的电视屏幕上，他们的食谱书也经常登上畅销书榜榜首。

ex.s: To ask for a reading list.
ex.t: 请求一份阅读清单。

ex.s: Soon, the cast list was ___7___.
ex.t: 很快，演员名单____了。

ex.s: You could ask a friend or family member to help add to your list. ____19____ That way, you could exchange thoughts on what makes each of you special and the aspects of your personality that shine through.
ex.t: 你可以请朋友或家人帮你补充这个清单。____19____ 这样，你们就可以交流想法，谈谈是什么让彼此与众不同，以及你们性格中闪光的方面。

ex.s: It’s the only Thai restaurant that ranks among the top 10 of the word’s 50 best restaurants list.
ex.t: 它是唯一一家跻身全球50家最佳餐厅榜单前十的泰国餐厅。

ex.s: You may change your class schedule during the first two weeks of the term by adding or dropping courses from your enrollment list.
ex.t: 你可以在学期前两周通过从注册清单中添加或退掉课程来更改你的课表。

ex.s: Students often attend classes in which they are not enrolled on the first day of instruction to try adding this new course to the list, as other students may have dropped it.
ex.t: 学生经常在第一天去上他们未注册的课程，试图把这门新课加入清单，因为其他学生可能已经退课了。

ex.s: But they usually have some elements in common: rather than a list of dry facts, stories have plots and they introduce characters.
ex.t: 但它们通常有一些共同元素：故事有情节并引入人物，而不是一列干巴巴的事实。

ex.s: The benefits of regular exercise are well documented but there’s a new bonus to add to the ever-growing list.
ex.t: 定期锻炼的好处已有充分记载，但在这个不断增长的清单上又增加了一个新好处。

ex.s: If a session is full, you can register for the waiting list.
ex.t: 如果课程已满，你可以注册候补名单。

ex.s: When you are placed on a waiting list, we will email you a number which tells you where you are on the list.
ex.t: 当你被列入候补名单时，我们会发邮件给你一个号码，告诉你在名单上的位置。

ex.s: If you are close to the front of the list, you have a good chance of gaining a place in the programme in the near future.
ex.t: 如果你接近名单前列，你在不久的将来很有可能获得项目名额。

ex.s: If you miss two PASS sessions in a row, you will be deregistered and your place will be given to someone on the waiting list.
ex.t: 如果你连续错过两次PASS课程，你将被取消注册，你的位置将给候补名单上的人。

ex.s: Sign up for the waiting list.
ex.t: 注册候补名单。

ex.s: Email the office their numbers on the list.
ex.t: 发邮件给办公室他们在名单上的号码。

ex.s: What is on David's list?
ex.t: 大卫的清单上有什么？

ex.s: What is on David’s list?
ex.t: 大卫的清单上有什么？

ex.s: When you were trying to figure out what to buy for the environmentalist on your holiday list, fur probably didn’t cross your mind.
ex.t: 当你在为假期名单上的环保主义者挑选礼物时，毛皮可能根本不会出现在你的脑海中。

ex.s: If a popular magazine you want isn't offered and the library keeps a list of such requests, they may bring it in when enough interest is shown.
ex.t: 如果你想要的流行杂志图书馆没有，而图书馆保留了此类请求的清单，当有足够兴趣时他们可能会购进。

ex.s: Students should read the list with their parents / carers, and select two activities they would like to do.
ex.t: 学生应与父母/监护人一起阅读清单，并选择两项他们想参加的活动。

ex.s: When your boss or professor sends you out to do man-on-the-street interviews for a story, think about the topic and develop a list of about ten general questions relating to it.
ex.t: 当你的老板或教授派你去做街头采访时，先思考这个话题并列出大约十个与之相关的一般性问题。

ex.s: To remember all the questions you have when you are not in the doctor's office, write them down and bring the list with you to your appointment.____20____Remember—there's no such thing as a stupid question.
ex.src: 2020全国新高考II卷·Talking with your doctor
ex.t: 为了记住你在不在医生办公室时想到的所有问题，把它们写下来，带着清单去就诊。____20____记住——没有愚蠢的问题这回事。

ex.s: Oh, 8____ you 9____(finish) the guest list yet, dear?
ex.t: 哦，亲爱的，你完成客人名单了吗？

ex.s: So we still need to prepare food and drinks I'll make a checklist Preparation choose presents for Grandma draw up the guest list on Wednesday make invitations prepare food and drinks on Sunday morning Who's responsible?
ex.t: 所以我们还需要准备食物和饮料。我来列个清单：准备——给奶奶选礼物；星期三拟好客人名单；做邀请函；准备食物和饮料；星期天早上——谁负责？

ex.s: Most trains operate just once a day and some run only three times a week, so missing yours can be a disaster. ____39____ Note: The times listed on the schedules are departure times, not arrival times.
ex.t: 大多数火车每天只运行一班，有些一周只运行三次，所以错过你的火车可能是一场灾难。____39____注意：时刻表上列出的是发车时间，不是到达时间。

defs.def: the fact of a ship leaning to one side （船的）倾斜
to write a list of things in a particular order （按某次序）把 … 列表，列清单，造表

ex.s: This is why making lists is important in any productivity handbook.
ex.t: 这就是为什么在任何效率手册中列清单都很重要。

ex.s: This nice Cantonese restaurant in Columbia Heights quickly became a destination for chef Henji Cheung’s Hong Kong-style cooking and co-owner Sarah Thompson’s natural wine list that earned her a Michelin nod.
ex.t: 这家位于哥伦比亚高地的不错的粤餐厅，凭借主厨Henji Cheung的港式烹饪和合伙人Sarah Thompson的天然酒单迅速成为热门去处，酒单还为她赢得了米其林的认可。

ex.s: Please review the List of Available Projects and fill out the Group Project Request Form.
ex.t: 请查阅“可参与项目列表”并填写团体项目申请表。

ex.s: Unfortunately, there is no magic list I can offer.
ex.t: 遗憾的是，我没有什么神奇的清单可以提供。

ex.s: Changing Your Course Enrollment List
ex.t: 更改你的课程注册清单。

ex.s: What is the deadline for a free enrollment list change?
ex.t: 免费更改注册清单的截止日期是什么时候？

ex.s: What is on the ever-growing list mentioned in the first paragraph?
ex.t: 第一段中提到的不断增长的清单上是什么？

ex.s: For the biggest stadiums in the world, we have used data supplied by the World Atlas list so far, which ranks them by their stated permanent capacity, as well as updated information from official stadium websites.
ex.t: 对于世界上最大的体育场，我们到目前为止使用了世界地图册提供的数据，该地图册按公布的固定容量排名，以及来自官方体育场网站的更新信息。

ex.s: Your medical history is a list of your illnesses, treatments, what the doctors told you to do, and anything else you think your doctor should know.
ex.src: 2020全国新高考II卷·Talking with your doctor
ex.t: 你的病史是一份你患过的疾病、接受的治疗、医生嘱咐你做的事以及任何你认为医生应该知道的事情的清单。

ex.s: Bring your medical history, including a list of your current medicines.
ex.src: 2020全国新高考II卷·Talking with your doctor
ex.t: 带上你的病史，包括你目前所用药物的清单。

ex.s: 40   Turn to a page in your journal to your list of strengths and achievements.
ex.t: 40 翻到日记中你写的优点和成就清单那一页。

ex.s: Each year my children would write up their Christmas wish lists.
ex.t: 每年孩子们都会写下他们的圣诞愿望清单。

ex.s: 37   Some people register a list of things they want or need for their new home at a local or store or stores.
ex.t: 37 有些人会在当地商店登记一份他们想要或需要为新家准备的东西的清单。

ex.s: It was the first traditional Chinese festival added to UNESCO’s List of Intangible Cultural Heritage.
ex.t: 这是第一个入选联合国教科文组织非物质文化遗产名录的中国传统节日。

ex.s: Student A is visiting your town and has a list of things to do.
ex.t: 学生A正在访问你的城镇，有一串要做的事情的清单。

ex.s: ●Now that you’ve listed your strengths, list your imperfections.
ex.t: 既然你已经列出了自己的优点，现在就列出你的缺点吧。

ex.s: Now list all the characteristics you like about yourself.
ex.t: 现在列出你喜欢自己的所有特质。

ex.s: List all of your accomplishments and achievements.
ex.t: 列出你所有的成就和功绩。

ex.s: It's important that an applicant’s resume list any activities that involved teamwork and goal-driven responsibilities.
ex.t: 求职者的简历中列出任何涉及团队合作和目标导向责任的活动的很重要。

defs.def: to mention or include sb/sth in a list 列举；把 … 列入一览表

ex.s: The house is now listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
ex.t: 这座房子如今已被列入《国家史迹名录》。

ex.s: In 1975, grizzlies were listed under the Endangered Species Act.
ex.t: 1975年，灰熊被列入《濒危物种法》保护名录。

ex.s: For now, grizzlies remain listed.
ex.t: 目前，灰熊仍在保护名录上。

ex.s: It also listed her favorite sports and activities, and provided her phone number. ___39___
ex.t: 通知中还列出了她最喜欢的运动和活动，并提供了电话号码。___39___

ex.s: 23.What do the listed stadiums have in common?
ex.t: 列出的这些体育场有什么共同点？

ex.s: He said that he had heard the calls to preserve the boxes and had seen how some of them were listed as historic buildings.
ex.t: 他说他听到了保护这些箱子的呼吁，也看到其中一些被列为历史建筑。

ex.s: Why does the author list great philosophers in paragraph 4?
ex.t: 作者为什么在第四段列举伟大的哲学家？

ex.s: It lists your performance against other runners in your social network.
ex.t: 它列出你在社交网络中与其他跑步者相比的表现。

defs.def: to be put or put sth in a list of things for sale （被）列入销售清单，列入价目表

ex.s: At the top of a second page, put the heading “Acts of kindness.” On this one, list all the positive things you’ve done for others.
ex.t: 在第二页的顶部写下标题“善举”。在这一页上，列出你为他人做过的所有积极的事情。
